about:
Hi, I am Harshitha Sontika, an AI Software Engineer and full stack developer passionate about building scalable web applications, secure backend systems, and cloud native architectures that solve real-world problems.

With around 2+ years of hands-on experience spanning fintech, non-profit, and startup environments, I’ve delivered products that improved task accuracy by 25%, reduced hallucinations by 20%, increased processing efficiency by 35%, and achieved 99.9% uptime on AWS.

On the frontend, I specialize in React.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript, crafting responsive and accessible interfaces. On the backend, I bring deep experience in Java (Spring Boot) and Python (FastAPI), building secure and high-performing REST APIs, GraphQL services, and distributed architectures.

My toolkit includes Docker, AWS (EC2, S3, ECS), Azure DevOps, and Jenkins for automation and deployment, along with strong database experience in PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, SQL Server, and Oracle. I’m also skilled in OAuth 2.0 and JWT-based authentication, ensuring system security and scalability.

I thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments where I can turn complex technical challenges into clean, reliable solutions that drive real business impact.
